picks.title: Nvidia-backed SiFive hits $3.65 billion valuation for open AI chips
picks.why_it_matters: RISC-V's growing traction in AI infrastructure signals a potential platform shift away from ARM/x86 dominance, creating opportunities for startups building on open chip architectures.

picks.title: Cirrus Labs to join OpenAI

picks.title: Small models also found the vulnerabilities that Mythos found
